title: Coherent word comparisons from supplied generator maps and a reconstruction unit
statement:
Let $S$ be a set of indices and, for each $s\in S$, let $\mathcal D_s,\mathcal T_s$ be categories [def-nagata-category], with a full subcategory $\mathcal E_s\subseteq\mathcal D_s$ (all morphisms between its objects are retained). Let $R_s:\mathcal D_s\to\mathcal T_s$ and $L_s:\mathcal T_s\to\mathcal D_s$ be functors and $\eta_s:1_{\mathcal D_s}\to L_sR_s$ a natural transformation whose components on $\mathcal E_s$ are isomorphisms. Functors preserve identities and compositions; natural transformations here are families of morphisms commuting with the functor images of every morphism.
For each directed generating edge $e:s\to t$ choose functors $F_e:\mathcal D_s\to\mathcal D_t$ and $G_e:\mathcal T_s\to\mathcal T_t$, with $F_e(\mathcal E_s)\subseteq\mathcal E_t$, and a natural transformation $q_e:R_tF_e\to G_eR_s$ whose components on $\mathcal E_s$ are isomorphisms. No geometric description of these generators or construction of $q_e$ is assumed.

A word $W=(e_1,\ldots,e_m):s\to t$ is a finite composable edge sequence; set $F_W=F_{e_m}\cdots F_{e_1}$ and $G_W=G_{e_m}\cdots G_{e_1}$ with a fixed recursive parenthesization, and set both empty composites to the identity. There is a unique family of natural transformations $q_W:R_tF_W\to G_WR_s$ with empty-word map $q_{1_s}=1_{R_s}$, the prescribed one-edge maps, and
$$q_{eW}=(G_eq_W)\circ(q_eF_W).$$
On $\mathcal E_s$, every $F_W$ takes values in $\mathcal E_t$, and both $q_W$ and
$$a_W=L_t(q_W)\circ(\eta_tF_W):F_W\longrightarrow L_tG_WR_s$$
are natural isomorphisms. For any words $W:s\to t$ and $V:t\to v$, the specified maps obey
$$q_{VW}=(G_Vq_W)\circ(q_VF_W)$$
after the canonical associativity and identity isomorphisms for composition of functors. The empty-word map $a_{1_s}$ is $\eta_s$.

More explicitly, let $E$ be any binary expression of composition with the same ordered edges as $W$, allowing empty words as identity factors. Denote its functor composites by $F_E,G_E$, and recursively define $q_{(E_2E_1)}=(G_{E_2}q_{E_1})\circ(q_{E_2}F_{E_1})$, starting with the given edge and empty-word maps. Let $c_E:F_W\xrightarrow{\sim}F_E$ and $d_E:G_W\xrightarrow{\sim}G_E$ be the canonical flattening isomorphisms, obtained by reassociation and removal of identity factors, and put $a_E=L_t(q_E)\circ(\eta_tF_E)$. Then, as equalities of natural transformations on $\mathcal D_s$,
$$ (d_ER_s)\circ q_W=q_E\circ R_t(c_E),\qquad L_t(d_ER_s)\circ a_W=a_E\circ c_E.$$
Consequently these comparisons are independent of binary parenthesization and insertion of empty factors, with no faithfulness assumption on $R_s$ or $L_s$.
